name: debug80-toolchain
description: Workspace for the Debug80 Z80 development toolchain

scripts.build: npm run build -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run build -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && npm run build -w @jhlagado/z80-tool-services && npm run build -w atom-z80 && npm run build -w @jhlagado/nucleus && npm run build -w debug80
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run typecheck -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && npm run typecheck -w @jhlagado/z80-tool-services && npm run typecheck -w @jhlagado/azm-headless-integration && npm run typecheck -w debug80 && npm run typecheck:webview -w debug80 && npm run typecheck -w @jhlagado/nucleus
scripts.test: npm run test -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run test -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && npm run test -w @jhlagado/z80-tool-services && npm run test -w atom-z80 && npm run test -w @jhlagado/azm-headless-integration && npm run test -w debug80 && npm run test -w @jhlagado/nucleus
scripts.build:cpm22: npm run build -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run build -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && npm run verify:cpm22 -w atom-z80 && node scripts/cpm22/build-image.mjs
scripts.measure:cpm22-editor: npm run build -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run build -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && node scripts/cpm22/measure-editor-buffers.mjs
scripts.measure:cpm22-editor-search: npm run build -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run build -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && node scripts/cpm22/measure-editor-search.mjs
scripts.measure:cpm22-editor-new-file: npm run build -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run build -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && node scripts/cpm22/measure-editor-new-file.mjs
scripts.measure:cpm22-editor-replace: npm run build -w @jhlagado/azm && npm run build -w @jhlagado/debug80-runtime && node scripts/cpm22/measure-editor-replace.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:assembler-selections && npm run check:azm-dependency-inventory && npm run check:cpm22-atom-candidates && npm run check:atom-e2e-fixtures && npm run test
scripts.package:nucleus: npm run test:package -w @jhlagado/nucleus && npm run check:atom -w @jhlagado/nucleus
